title: Simultaneous lifting of finitely many functions on affine inverse-image charts
statement:
Fix a universe $u$. Let $I$ be a small cofiltered category in that universe (nonempty, every pair of objects has a common predecessor, and every pair of parallel arrows is equalized after precomposition). Let $D:I\to\mathrm{Sch}_u$ be a diagram of schemes [def-pc-scheme] whose transition morphisms are affine [pqf-def-affine-morphism], and let $(X,(\pi_i)_i)$ be a limit cone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Fix $i\in I$, a finite set $A$, an affine open $U_a\subseteq D_i$ for each $a\in A$, and a section $s_a\in\Gamma(\pi_i^{-1}U_a,\mathcal O_X)$ for each $a$. There exist an object $j\in I$, one arrow $h:j\to i$, and sections
$$
 t_a\in\Gamma(D(h)^{-1}U_a,\mathcal O_{D_j})\qquad(a\in A)
$$
whose pullbacks along $\pi_j$ equal $s_a$, using the equality $\pi_j^{-1}(D(h)^{-1}U_a)=\pi_i^{-1}U_a$ supplied by the cone identity. No quasi-compactness or quasi-separatedness hypothesis on the whole stages is required.
